_comment: The draw bench's build (DrawBench/README.md, 'Build order'): each stage after the frame and its materials, as its rig's parts draw them; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). A stage's items go in one material a click, as many as it takes at once: the endless chain is two of the game's chains, the mandrel bar and the follower's spindle two rods. The mandrel stage also takes the follower's spring, in a click of its own before or after the rods, while springs exist (ifExists: the MandrelSprings switch). The die is the wearing part, fitted with the last stage and durable: it goes in with the durability it has left (uses is DrawBenchSettings.DieDurability, set when the game loads), is worn DieWearPerHollow a tube blank, comes back out by Ctrl with what is left, and a spent one is gone. No block: the bench's construction record is its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic one.
